comment: The DEPTH jack is declared at Detune_info.hh:54 and drawn on the panel, but the string 'Depth' appears nowhere in DetuneCore.cc: nothing reads it. The maker's manual describes the two CV jacks the other way round, giving DETUNE the speeds and DEPTH the depths, while DetuneCore.cc:79-80 add the DETUNE jack to the depths. The WOW SPEED knob is configured to 5.33hz (Detune_info.hh:19) and the manual repeats that, but DetuneCore.cc:92 maps it to 5Hz.
